google-calendar.description: Put scheduled work orders on a Google Calendar, add a Google Meet link, and see the calendar's busy time in Torqvoice.
google-calendar.tenantHelp: Create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials), enable the Google Calendar API, add the redirect URI below, and paste the client id and secret here.

settings.pushEnabled: Add scheduled work orders to this calendar
settings.includeCustomer: Include the customer's name and phone in the event
settings.addConference: Add a Google Meet link to each event
settings.addConferenceHelp: The link is shown on the work order so you can share it with the customer.
settings.pullEnabled: Show this calendar's busy time on the Torqvoice calendar
settings.pullEnabledHelp: Read-only. Refreshed every 15 minutes, one week back and two months ahead.

microsoft-365.description: Put scheduled work orders on an Outlook calendar, add a Microsoft Teams link, and see the calendar's busy time in Torqvoice.
microsoft-365.tenantHelp: Register an application in Microsoft Entra (App registrations), allow personal and work accounts, add the redirect URI below as a Web platform, create a client secret, and paste both here.

settings.pushEnabled: Add scheduled work orders to this calendar
settings.includeCustomer: Include the customer's name and phone in the event
settings.addConference: Add a Microsoft Teams link to each event
settings.addConferenceHelp: The link is shown on the work order so you can share it with the customer.
settings.pullEnabled: Show this calendar's busy time on the Torqvoice calendar
settings.pullEnabledHelp: Read-only. Refreshed every 15 minutes, one week back and two months ahead.

zoom.description: Add a Zoom meeting to a scheduled work order and keep the join link on it, for remote diagnosis or walking a customer through findings.
zoom.tenantHelp: In the Zoom App Marketplace, build a General app (user-managed), add the redirect URI below, add the scopes meeting:write:meeting, meeting:update:meeting, meeting:delete:meeting, meeting:read:meeting and user:read:user, and paste the client ID and secret here.

settings.autoCreate: Create a Zoom meeting for every scheduled work order automatically
settings.autoCreateHelp: Off: you add a video call to a work order yourself, from its page. On: every work order with a start time gets a meeting, moved when it is rescheduled and removed when it is cancelled. Either way the customer only gets the link when you send it.
settings.includeCustomer: Include the customer's name in the meeting topic
settings.joinBeforeHost: Let the customer join before you

vegvesen.description: Fill in a vehicle from its Norwegian plate or VIN: make, model, year, fuel, gearbox, engine, colour, tyre sizes and the next EU-kontroll date, straight from Statens vegvesen's register. No owner data is returned.

fields.apiKeyHelp: Free. Order the key on vegvesen.no under "API for tekniske kjøretøyopplysninger": sign in with BankID, represent the workshop, and the key is issued at once. It allows 50,000 lookups a day.

settings.syncInspections: Keep inspection dates up to date for every vehicle in this workshop
settings.syncInspectionsHelp: Once an hour, vehicles that have not been checked recently are looked up by plate and their next EU-kontroll date is saved. Only vehicles stored in this workshop are ever sent. A vehicle is rechecked monthly, and weekly once its deadline is within two months.

openapi-automotive.description: Fill in a vehicle from its French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese or British plate: make, model, year, VIN, fuel, engine size and more, from the country's registration data through Openapi.com. Each lookup is billed to the workshop's own Openapi account. No owner data is returned.

fields.tokenHelp: Create an account on console.openapi.com, add credit to the wallet, and under Automotive create a token for the production environment. Each successful lookup costs a few tens of cents; a miss is free.

settings.countryHelp: The registry to search. French and Italian plates look the same, so the country cannot be read off the plate.
settings.bikesHelp: When a plate is not a car, ask the motorcycle registry too. A miss on the car side is free, so this costs nothing extra unless a motorcycle is found. Not available for Portugal.

rdw.description: Fill in a vehicle from its Dutch plate: make, model, year, fuel, engine size, colour, weights and the next APK date, straight from RDW's open vehicle register. Free, no key needed. No owner data and no VIN are published.

fields.appTokenHelp: RDW's open data works without a key, but anonymous requests share a throttled pool. For the inspection sync, create a free account on opendata.rdw.nl, open your profile's developer settings and create an app token.

settings.syncInspections: Keep APK dates up to date for every vehicle in this workshop
settings.syncInspectionsHelp: Once an hour, vehicles that have not been checked recently are looked up by plate and their next APK date is saved. Only vehicles stored in this workshop are ever sent. A vehicle is rechecked monthly, and weekly once its deadline is within two months.
